# AI investigation status card

Desktop and mobile previews of the production `InvestigationNotStartedCard` component, rendered with representative test data. These previews illustrate a monitor cooldown; they do not claim to establish the original skip reason of a production alert.

The card shows the reason, whether it was recorded at creation or inferred from current settings, and an appropriate next step. Desktop uses a two-column layout; mobile stacks the explanation and next step.
